title: SkyBlock Enhanced
description: The only Hypixel SkyBlock modpack you need. Built for modern Minecraft — 60+ optimized mods, a guided setup wizard, and a config system no other pack comes close to match.
body:
![SkyBlock Enhanced banner featuring floating island worlds with a portal structure on the left and a village settlement on the right against a cloudy sky background, with decorative golden corner frames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce62b33a0f6a79c01c8dd1e85de2f0d08861c5ad.png)
**Skyblock Enhanced** the only Hypixel SkyBlock pack you'll ever need! Over 60 mods for **Minecraft 26.1+ (Fabric)**, covering everything you need — performance, dungeons, Bazaar, quality of life and much more — bundled and ready to go. One install, one quick wizard, and you're playing. Spend time on the game not your mods! [![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/project/e0oMrxjp) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/skyblock-enhanced) [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/pdwxyjTta7) [![Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/kdgaming1)
![Decorative divider displaying 'DESCRIPTION'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5d6fe06a834eaa09a0f3a2abb826c1cb37b5cec.webp) **With over 1 million downloads, SkyBlock Enhanced has helped thousands of players make their experience better — and you can get same enhanced experience:** - **Default configs.** Close to a hundred hours have been spent reading every mod's config, learning what each option does, and tuning them so every part of the game is as smooth as possible — hundreds of QoL features, big and small, already set up for you. On top of that, there are **6 resolution versions** of the configs: same base settings, but with every HUD overlay individually positioned so nothing overlaps or sits awkwardly, no matter your monitor. - **In-game Config Manager.** Ever lost your configs? Never again. The pack backs them up on every update and every three days, so if they're ever wiped you can restore them in one click. - **Performance mods + optimized settings.** Dozens of hours spent researching optimization mods and tweaking settings to give you the smoothest gameplay possible. - **Custom SkyBlock-themed menu.** Makes it feel like you're booting up a dedicated game, not just vanilla Minecraft. - **One-click updates** through the Modrinth App. - **Plus so much more!** ![Decorative divider displaying 'FEATURES'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec3227c1e61d07fb81d9d5b353b92d9121083934.webp) ## Setup Wizard On first launch, a guided wizard configures everything for you. Some steps only appear if the relevant mod is installed. |Step|What it does| |---|---| |Welcome|Quick intro and support info| |Config Packs|Apply, import, reapply, or restore config packs| |Main Menu Design|Pick your title-screen style| |Performance Profile|Choose your FPS/visuals balance (see below)| |Tab Design|Compact or fancy player list| |Item Background|How item rarity is shown| |Storage Design|Overlay or vanilla storage UI| |Dungeon Routes|Skyblocker waypoints or Stella| |Sword Block|Toggle 1.8.9-style sword block| |ScamScreener|Set scam alert level and pings| |Caxton Font|Pick a custom font pack| |Resource Packs|Choose from the included packs| |Confirm & Apply|Review every choice before anything changes| ### Performance Profiles - **Performance** — lowest visuals, maximum FPS for low-end hardware - **Balanced** — close to default, recommended for most players - **Quality** — high render distance and maxed visuals for strong PCs - **Shaders (Balanced / Quality)** — the above with shaders enabled _(note: shaders may break some in-world overlays)_ ### Resolution Presets UI overlays shift with resolution and GUI scale — what looks clean at 1080p can overlap at 1440p. Six presets ship with every HUD overlay positioned for that exact setup, and the right one is applied automatically: `1080p 2×` · `1080p 3×` · `1440p` · `1440p Ultrawide` · `4K` · `4K Ultrawide` ### In-Game Config Manager Lost your configs easily? Restore backups and so much more with the custom-made Config Manager: - **Apply** official presets or your own - **Export** selected configs as a shareable `.zip` (with name, author, and target resolution) - **Import** a config pack, preview it, and apply - **Back up & restore** at any time — a backup is also made automatically before any preset is applied > Spent hours perfecting a 1440p layout? Export it, share the `.zip`, and a friend imports it in seconds.
Screenshots ![SkyBlock Enhanced welcome wizard page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/843d109be2b57578d28258090707c3892f77a546.png) ![Wizard main menu selection page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b522fef80c8955a55662b776a9f7d22ec251db5c.jpeg) ![Wizard performance profile page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c2b3a8db0af89b7eb8a02bcc038a3e614e73adf.jpeg) ![Wizard tab list design page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25b7321c83d3c4af3f2db2a734b764352d6e667c.jpeg) ![Wizard item background page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/baf703e54e42071af247e0286dea4540b4dbe03b.png) ![Wizard storage design page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c36a70e93fafa96e245b7cc88ed78d6f38b8c320.jpeg) ![Wizard sword block page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e74f9516e7967a69e9b833284b713cc0bbcdd2a2.jpeg) ![Wizard ScamScreener page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/929a0f7a589a566127048e47b8253387cd76645c_0.webp) ![Wizard resource pack selection page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0043acd14d07c4cff1c1a98f7200738dc15a8450.png) ![Wizard review and apply page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a80e104b4360a029b6c2e4d74d7adb77b2f85e8_0.webp) ![Config Manager main screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec64613b3da9f24f008ecdf10683b3a7534cf1bc.png) ![Config Manager export screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e64e573ed5dcbc982ae0ef477d35803ea56e8b3d.png) ![Config Manager backup restore screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78973ca80a8f7fb581ccf4c97083c4084fff9887.png) ![Config Manager import screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5331b40269dea7a06e46a613fe94c2699cdd58aa.png)
--- ## Quality-of-Life Mods The big SkyBlock mods, pre-configured for a clean screen. Expand each for details.
SkyHanni — all-round QoL Farming crop trackers with money-per-hour, Diana/Mythological Ritual helpers, Slayer and damage helpers, mineshaft detection with party chat, plus customizable HUDs, a cleaner scoreboard, and chat improvements.
Skyblocker — all-round QoL Dungeon puzzle solvers, secret waypoints, and a full dungeon HUD; mining/foraging/commission waypoints; customizable health, mana, defense, and XP bars; Bazaar/AH prices in tooltips; built-in wiki lookup, profile viewer, and event timers.
Odin — dungeons & Kuudra Endgame PvE utility: puzzle solvers for most Floor 7 terminals and dungeon puzzles, Wither Dragon tracking, Melody helpers, full run stats, and Kuudra pearl waypoints and supply tracking. Everything is optional and configurable.
ScamScreener — safety Scans chat in real time for scam patterns (phishing links, fake verification, suspicious invites) with optional **local** AI scoring — nothing leaves your machine. Warns during trades and invites, with manual blacklisting.
Other SkyBlock mods - **SkyBlock Profile Viewer** — a modern `/pv` with tabs for skills, slayers, catacombs, pets, and more - **Modern Warp Menu** — a clean warp interface with rendered island views - **SkyBlock Enhancements** — small tweaks: missing-enchant detection, command-confirm disabler, `/reminder` - **Scale Me** — scale your model, other players, NPCs, and held items; includes 1.8 sword block - **Bazaar Utils** — faster, safer Bazaar trading: custom buttons, mistake prevention, one-click undercut, bookmarks - **SkyOcean** — slayers, fishing, mining, and garden helpers, item value screen, and searchable storage - **Skyblock Enhanced Storage** — all your Ender Chests and Backpacks in one searchable overlay - **Enhanced Chat** — chat quality-of-life improvements
⌨️ Essential Keybinds **General** - `F7` – Move GUI / Editor - `M` – Warp Menu - `K` – Toggle Shaders **Wiki & Info (Skyblocker)** - `F1` – Fandom Wiki (hover item) · `F4` – Hypixel Wiki (hover item) · `F6` – Item Price Lookup **Item Management (Skyblocker)** - `P` – Protect Item · `H` – Lock Hotbar Slot · `Z` – Bazaar Refresh **SkyHanni** - `X` – Chat Peek · `Z` – Garden Home / Mining Spot · `H` – Set Garden Home / Rep Helper - `B` – Barn Teleport · `V` – Warp to Pest / Trapper · `R` – Reset Fishing Timer - `Y` – Share Waypoint · `K` – Accept Visitor · `Left Shift` – Fortune Breakdown · `Left Ctrl` – Bypass Refuse Prevention **SkyOcean** - `O` – Item Search · `J` – Item Value · `C` – Set Craft Helper Item
--- ## Custom Main Menu A SkyBlock-themed menu, chosen in the wizard: - **Modern** — fully custom menu with a custom background - **Modern Minimal** — custom buttons over the default panorama - **Minimal** — vanilla menu with a change log button (recommend if you use other mods that add main menu buttons)
Screenshots ![SkyBlock Enhanced modern main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6702a73a4772b3e1781f37ec15be1c68aef77960.png) ![SkyBlock Enhanced modern minimal main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/593436165bbe801b885ded1b7243b1104bdf908d.jpeg) ![SkyBlock Enhanced minimal main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98a3fc16f4c0f531feebcd695a12aea8d4f20c4f.jpeg)
![Decorative divider displaying 'HOW TO INSTALL'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddf761f6395832702f207516c1d44cba2f5eb151.webp) ## Installation You'll need a valid **Minecraft Java** account and the free **[Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)**. 1. **Install the Modrinth App** — download it, run the installer, and let it open. 2. **Log in** — click **Playing as** (top-right) → **Log in**, and sign in with your Microsoft account. 3. **Install the pack** — go to **Discover content** → **Modpacks**, search **SkyBlock Enhanced**, and click **Install**. 4. **Allocate RAM** — open the instance's **gear icon → Java and Memory**, enable **Custom Memory Allocation**, and set it using the table below. |System RAM|Recommended| |---|---| |8 GB|3–4 GB| |16 GB|4–6 GB| |32 GB+|6–8 GB| > **Check your RAM:** `Ctrl + Shift + Esc` → Performance → Memory. ![Decorative divider displaying 'Mod List'](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19ea0e1624809374d39957579dd400b727e66341.webp) All mods are **Hypixel-safe**, client-side, and do not automate gameplay.

🧩 General **Q: What is SkyBlock Enhanced?** A: A pre-configured Hypixel SkyBlock modpack for **Minecraft 26.1+** on **Fabric**, with 60+ optimized mods, a first-launch wizard, six resolution presets, and an in-game config manager — ready to go with no manual setup. **Q: Can I use it on Hypixel?** A: Yes. All included mods are allowed on Hypixel, are client-side, and don't automate gameplay. Always check Hypixel's rules before adding your own mods. **Q: Do I have to configure anything manually?** A: No — install through the Modrinth App, launch, follow the wizard, and play.
⚙️ Installation & Setup **Q: How do I install it?** A: Use the Modrinth App — see the installation steps above. **Q: The game won't start or crashes.** A: Allocate more RAM, add `-Xss4M` if you see "Resource Reload Failed", and make sure you're on a compatible, up-to-date Java runtime (the Modrinth App handles this automatically). Still stuck? Join the Discord. **Q: How do I update?** A: Click **Update pack** in the Modrinth App and pick the latest version.
🚀 Performance **Q: Will it run on a low-end PC?** A: Yes — pick the **Performance** profile in the wizard. **Q: Do shaders work?** A: Yes — Iris with Complementary Unbound and MakeUp Ultra Fast are included. Some overlays may not display correctly with shaders on.
🧰 Customization **Q: What resolution presets are there?** A: Six: **1080p 2×**, **1080p 3×**, **1440p**, **1440p Ultrawide**, **4K**, and **4K Ultrawide** — applied automatically on first launch. **Q: Can I reset or share my config?** A: Yes — the in-game Config Manager handles backups, restores, exports, and imports.
💬 Support & Community **Q: Where do I get help or report bugs?** A: Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/pdwxyjTta7). A [Fluxer](https://fluxer.gg/3jJy9cp6) server is also available if you prefer. **Q: How can I support the project?** A: Via [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/kdgaming1), or use **Bisect Hosting** code **SBE** for 25% off.
--- ## Community & Support Need help, want to share configs, or looking for updates? Join the Discord for support channels, config sharing, and release announcements. A privacy-focused [Fluxer](https://fluxer.gg/3jJy9cp6) server is also available. [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/pdwxyjTta7) ## Support the Project Donations fund continued updates and support — every bit is appreciated. Need a server? Use code **SBE** for **25% off** at [Bisect Hosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/SBE?r=SkyblockEnhancedModrinthPage). [![Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/kdgaming1) ![Bisect Hosting promotional banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01502d9d41e784dfa18a3a1903a3e906cde1af1f.webp) --- Thanks for choosing **SkyBlock Enhanced** — a modern, optimized, fully configured Hypixel SkyBlock modpack. If you enjoy it, **heart** it on Modrinth, **join the community**, and **share it** with friends. Happy grinding! — **Kd_Gaming1** _Special thanks to all the mod developers behind these mods, and to @ic22487 for the logo._
